text:
alex: Need to provision a new GPU nodepool in eu-west3 for next-week infer rollout. Target ~50 GPUs initially, mixed latency profiles (real-time low-latency + async batch). Any quota or network gotchas we should expect?

maria: Do we know exact instance types? h100 for real-time, a10g for batch? cost vs latency tradeoff.

kevin: eu-west3 has limited spare static NAT IPs in our account. Also our GPU quota is currently: GPUs=32, vCPUs=1200. We'll need a quota request to bump GPUs.

alex: ugh. NAT IPs — can we reuse existing Cloud NAT? we need stable egress for some customers (allowlisted IPs).

chandra: Re: NAT — we can either allocate more reserved static IPs + Cloud NAT or route egress via the central egress VPC with the proxy. Allocating certs for allowlist is faster if we get static IPs. But region has pool limits.

kevin: For instance types: h100 gives lower p99 latency but at ~3-4x cost vs a10g. Suggest split: start with 8x h100 for canary, 42x a10g for capacity. If quota forces smaller, start 8h100 + 16a10g and autoscale.

alex: sounds good. How about preemptible/spot mix? cheaper but eviction risk for real-time.

maria: Put latency-sensitive pods on tainted h100 nodes (taint: dedicated=latency:NoSchedule) and use PodPriority to avoid spot nodes. Batch can run on a10g spot.

chandra: Autoscaler config note: set minNodes on h100 pool to 2, maxNodes based on GPU quota. Use node-template with label "pool=infer-eu-west3" and taints. Also set scaleDownDelay and balance-similar-node-groups to false for mixed SKUs.

kevin: Quick snippet (gke nodepool-ish):
```
nodePools:
  - name: infer-h100
    machineType: a2-megagpu-...-h100
    accelerators: [{type: "nvidia-h100", count: 1}]
    preemptible: false
    min: 2
    max: 8
    taints: [{key: "dedicated", value: "latency", effect: "NO_SCHEDULE"}]
  - name: infer-a10g
    machineType: n1-standard-32
    accelerators: [{type: "nvidia-a10g", count: 1}]
    preemptible: true
    min: 0
    max: 50
```

chandra: Also add a ClusterAutoscaler annotation to both node pools and set --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m for faster reclaiming. For mixed pools consider CA's expander: least-waste or priority.

infra-bot: quota_request_created: ID qreq-2026-9931 for GPUs (requested +40 GPUs). Estimated approval 24-72h.

alex: Thanks infra-bot. Action items: (1) kevin open quota ticket for NAT IPs, (2) I will open a terraform PR with nodepool defs (start smaller), (3) chandra to share autoscaler flags and taints example.

maria: One more thing — update Cost Centre tag on compute resources and add a cost-monitoring alert for unexpected burst: billing.alerts/infer-eu-west3.

kevin: If quota is slow, fallback plan: start in europe-west1 with available NAT IPs and larger GPU quota, then migrate. Not ideal but unblocks rollout.

alex: OK. I'll proceed with PR and add canary route to h100. Will ping once PR is up. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — ping me for canary tests and perf thresholds.

chandra: I'll paste the final autoscaler flags in the PR comments. Also recommend PodDisruptionBudget for the real-time service to avoid rolling into shortages.

alex: noted. Closing thread when PR is up.
